name: Futei o Uru Tsuma Kawabuchi Hina
original_name: 不貞を売る妻・河渕日南
source:
The ordinary Kawabuchi couple enjoyed their simple happiness. They dreamed of
having children and expanding their family someday . However, a crisis struck the couple. The husband, Kawabuchi Kakuya, was laid off from his company and forced to quit. Losing his income meant that trying to conceive was out of the question. But his wife, Kawabuchi Hinami, respected Kakuya's feelings and told him that he wouldn't work for a company that treated him badly, promising to work herself as well, so she persuaded him to quit. Later, while Hinami was looking for work, a female colleague from when she worked at a relaxation salon appeared and told her about men's esthetic salons. She told her that men's esthetic salons were profitable, although they relied on attracting customers. At first, she refused, but out of necessity to make ends meet, she reluctantly started working at a men's esthetic salon. The shop was supposed to be a legitimate and relatively peaceful place—or so it seemed. If only the first customer she met on her first day, Tomoyasu Hideyo, hadn't offered her an "extra service"...
translation:
平凡的川渊夫妇享受着简单的幸福。他们梦想着
有一天生孩子并扩大家庭。然而，危机却降临到了这对夫妇身上。丈夫川渊角也被公司解雇，被迫辞职。失去收入意味着尝试怀孕是不可能的。但他的妻子川渊日南尊重角也的感受，告诉他不会在一家对他不好的公司工作，并承诺自己也会工作，所以她说服了他辞职。后来，日南在找工作的时候，一位在休闲沙龙工作的女同事出现了，向她介绍了男士美容沙龙。她告诉她，男士美容院虽然靠招揽顾客，但还是能赚钱的。起初她拒绝了，但出于养家糊口的需要，她无奈开始在男士美容沙龙工作。这家商店应该是一个合法且相对安静的地方——或者看起来是这样。要是她第一天遇到的第一个顾客智康英世没有给她提供“额外服务”就好了……
